test_title: PYST 60: SSC GD Constable - Reasoning (Held On - 24 Feb, 2024 Shift 2)
subject: reasoning
question: Six people Alice, Bob, Carol, David, Emily, and Frank are sitting on a circular table facing towards the centre. David sits between Alice and Emily. Carol sits to the immediate right of Bob. Frank and Alice are not neighbors. Carol is an immediate neighbour of Frank. Who sits to the immediate right of Emily?
solution:
**Given:** Six people Alice, Bob, Carol, David, Emily, and Frank are sitting on a circular table facing towards the centre. 

1) Carol sits to the immediate right of Bob.

2) Carol is an immediate neighbour of Frank.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/b01b5dfbed738c2a50c69cbc40fe3d02c2c253b21849256bc72e69e08a46ca3d.png] 

3) David sits between Alice and Emily.

4) Frank and Alice are not neighbors.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/79404406d44b64ec8df0087a7dc11523331047b3fe6494db43000c70ba69196d.png] 

Thus, according to the final arrangement David sits to the immediate right of Emily.

Hence, **"Option 3"** is the correct answer.
